paragraphs.text: This Psalm was composed by David in the name, and for the use of all the church and people of Israel, as a thanksgiving for their deliverance from some eminent danger or dangers from proud and potent enemies. Many such they had in David’s time; but which of them is here intended is hard to determine, and not worth the inquiry.
The church setteth forth God’s mercy for a miraculous deliverance, out of the apparent danger of powerful enemies, Psa 124:1-5, and blesseth him for it Psa 124:6-8.
they had speedily and utterly destroyed us, as Korah, &c. were, Num 16.
paragraphs.anchor: They had swallowed us up quick

paragraphs.text: for their great multitude, and swelling rage, and mighty force.
A metaphor from wild beasts, which tear and devour their prey with their teeth.
